intro: Across 53 articles dated 2026-04-12 to 2026-10-10, ZCyberNews tracked data-breach incidents spanning government, healthcare, education, technology, and retail. ShinyHunters, LockBit, and Booba appear among the top threat actors in this coverage. Reporting also referenced CVE-2026-35273 among the top CVEs. Affected regions included North america, United states, Europe, Global, and Canada. The severity mix comprised 41 high and 6 medium items, reflecting sustained attention to breach activity across these sectors and regions throughout the period.
